correctness.rationale: The exact completed-map result is correct. The denominator has scalar poles only in the open right half-plane, whereas h(P-I) has spectrum in the closed left half-plane; constants on both sides are conserved. An independent exact calculation in Q(h)[x]/(x^8-1) reproduced the four controlling numerator factorizations, and found nonnegative coefficients and a positive coefficient in each of the other four numerators. W is positive on h >= 0. Each controlling polynomial has one sign change and opposite leading and constant signs. The exact evaluations F_-(1)=2095, F_+(3)=-232938099, F_+(4)=1295141888, F_2(4)=-69805312 and F_3(4)=-363193856 give ell<1<3<u<4 and the two auxiliary roots above 4. Thus c_7 excludes (0,ell), c_1 excludes (u,infinity), all eight coefficients are nonnegative on the closed window, and T(0)=I. W(0)=2239488 and the coefficient -1296 of h^7 in Wc_7 give the claimed -1/1728 leading constant. To replay, invert 12-6h(x-1)+h^2(x-1)^2 modulo x^8-1 over Q(h), multiply by the numerator and reduce and clear the stated W before checking signs.
residual_risks: Only the homogeneous eight-state completed map and exact arithmetic are assessed; the calculation says nothing about internal stages or rounding near the endpoints.
